Absolutely, Tom! I think we should reach out to local business owners to gather their input on what topics would be most beneficial for them. Maybe we can also propose interactive sessions to engage everyone more effectively. What do you think?
I love that idea! Getting their input will definitely help tailor the workshops to their needs. Maybe we could draft a quick survey to share with them? It could also spark more interest in attending.

That's a great suggestion, Tom! I can start drafting the survey and we can brainstorm questions together. Also, we should think about how to promote the workshops once we have a clearer idea of the content.

I completely agree, Tom! Marketing strategies and financial management are crucial. Creative branding could really help differentiate local businesses too.
